Hey team,

We just signed up via the self-serve flow and selected a Dedicated capacity evaluation for a pilot. We're evaluating throughput for our inference layer (roughly 200–300 QPS sustained across bursts up to 600 QPS, 512-token median length). Can someone from Redwood help set up a short technical demo + ops walkthrough?

Basic details:
- Company: Quantify.ai
- Role: Platform + ML infra (I'm coordinating)
- Preferred timezone: PST/US West; mornings are best (9–11am PT)
- Must-have: discussion of batching, autoscale/burst, and KV-cache behavior for long chat contexts

I've CC'd procurement (procurement@quantify.ai) because we may need to talk about pilot terms.

Thanks,
Alexandra Ruiz
Head of Platform

Thanks Ben — both slots look good but Wed Mar 21 @ 9:00am PT is ideal.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Target sustained: 250 QPS (avg) with bursts to 600 QPS for 30s–2m windows.
- p95 latency target: <= 120ms for 512-token responses.
- Cold-start tolerance: we can tolerate 1–2s for a cold worker but would prefer sub-500ms for warm paths.

Attendees from our side: me (platform), Javier Morales (SRE), and procurement (on the thread). We may forward a short CSV of sample request distributions.

I see you mentioned a mutual action plan — please send that and any SRE checklist ahead of Wed so we can turn around any required infra changes.

Alexandra
